debate.key_bull_argument: Price above 200-EMA with MACD bullish crossover and three white soldiers pattern provide classic long-term trend confirmation and potential swing entry signal.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme VIX crisis (282), imminent earnings (14 days), weak ADX trend strength, below-average volume, and price below Hull MA create a high-risk environment that negates technical setup quality.
